name: DUB DESK
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Endless roots dub. A reggae band and an engineer who never leaves the desk.
description: DUB DESK turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into an endless roots dub session. A reggae band plays sixteen original riddims at 65 to 80 BPM: one-drop, rockers and steppers drums, a deep sub bass carrying the tune, guitar skank, organ bubble, now and then a melodica line or a horn stab. A virtual engineer mixes it live: drops to drum and bass, throws the snare into a tape echo, kicks the spring reverb, sweeps a high-pass, sounds the siren. The screen is the desk: faders moving by themselves, echo blips riding a tape loop, a shaking spring tank. Thirteen styles.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
